tools.name: get_posts
tools.description: Read a campaign's discovered posts with their drafted replies. Free. Use after generate_posts to inspect what was found, then review_posts / regenerate_replies to refine.

tools.name: submit_campaign_work
tools.description: Submit the user's work for a campaign. Three ways to prove it, and any one is enough: proof_url (content they published or an action they took), media_url (a hosted image or video made for the task — the ad-hoc creative case: a demo clip, a mockup, a designed asset), and description (max 500 chars).

tools.name: get_my_submissions
tools.description: The connected user's submissions to one campaign: pending / approved / rejected, with the reviewer's notes. Free, read-only. Use to report outcomes back to the user after submit_campaign_work.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: The connected user's participation totals: points, credit balance, and reply stats (submitted / approved / rejected / strikes) for work submitted through this connector. Free, read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_product, check_balance, create_campaign, get_campaign, generate_posts, get_posts, regenerate_replies, get_campaign_activity, get_campaign_results, update_campaign, set_campaign_schedule, find_opportunities, find_open_campaigns, get_campaign_brief, submit_campaign_work · Private data: create_product, create_campaign, get_campaign_brief · Public sink: check_balance, credit_history, boost_post, create_campaign, generate_posts, review_posts, regenerate_replies, update_campaign, set_campaign_schedule, find_opportunities, submit_participation, find_open_campaigns, submit_campaign_work · Destructive: create_product, create_campaign, run_research, generate_posts, review_posts, update_campaign, set_campaign_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_product, check_balance, create_campaign, get_campaign, generate_posts, get_posts, regenerate_replies, get_campaign_activity, get_campaign_results, update_campaign, set_campaign_schedule, find_opportunities, find_open_campaigns, get_campaign_brief, submit_campaign_work · Private data: create_product, create_campaign, get_campaign_brief · Public sink: check_balance, credit_history, boost_post, create_campaign, generate_posts, review_posts, regenerate_replies, update_campaign, set_campaign_schedule, find_opportunities, submit_participation, find_open_campaigns, submit_campaign_work · Destructive: create_product, create_campaign, run_research, generate_posts, review_posts, update_campaign, set_campaign_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
